review_state: Manual selection enabled for reviewed possibilities. Automatic recommendations and starts remain paused.
findings: Collector fetches public metadata, not full papers or discussion resolutions. This is suitable for leads, not recommendations.
Old digest sorted by first_seen and sampled six rows/source. It did not enforce publication-age windows.
Atom updated and Hugging Face lastModified could masquerade as publication dates. Existing records refreshed only last_seen, freezing stale metadata.
Curated public cards are exported separately from private worker briefs. There is no automatic semantic reconciliation; T6 counterevidence stayed in the private brief.
Worker research is bounded to roughly 12 minutes. Its source/read-depth limitations must survive into the dashboard, not disappear behind review_ready.
Schema/unit tests verify software contracts, not truth, research novelty, trend or commercial value.

collection.note: Counts by source include duplicate provenance. Dates are feed assertions pending primary-source verification. Eight empty channels are coverage gaps, not successful research.

candidates.headline: Recent source, insufficient support for the proposed experiment
candidates.finding: The October theory paper is adjacent evidence, not a test of approval fatigue or consequence previews. The private worker brief explicitly leaves novelty and recruitment unproven.
candidates.required_next: Need closest empirical interface studies, measurable hypotheses, power/recruitment feasibility and supervisor fit.

candidates.headline: Generic workflow-evaluation claim overlaps current work
candidates.finding: October work already evaluates stateful customer-support workflows and tool use. The dashboard linked only generic n8n documentation.
candidates.required_next: Define a specific failure class and compare against current workflow evaluators; verify dataset/tool access.

candidates.headline: Integration documentation is not a research gap
candidates.finding: Existing Bayesian sensor fusion was used to infer a new topic without recent unmet-need evidence or a feasible dataset.
candidates.required_next: A new evidence-backed question and actual sensor-data plan are required before reconsideration.

candidates.headline: Lighting shift is already part of the benchmark
candidates.finding: MVTec AD 2 already tests lighting differences. Original scope did not establish what existing calibration/adaptation studies leave unanswered.
candidates.required_next: Review 2026 challenge methods; choose an explicit remaining comparison and public split. Verify local runtime and non-commercial boundaries.

candidates.headline: Tutorial-led proposal without a dataset
candidates.finding: A transfer-learning tutorial does not establish a contribution. Current DCASE work directly addresses environmental noise and domain shifts.
candidates.required_next: Start from a current unresolved task and access to a suitable licensed dataset, not a classifier tutorial.

candidates.headline: Substantial recent overlap; dashboard omitted it
candidates.finding: Private worker brief already found October retail comparisons and warned that novelty is weak. July and October studies further overlap the broad question.
candidates.required_next: Do a precise comparison matrix before narrowing; dataset overlap and laptop feasibility remain untested. Preserve the existing brief as research, not endorsement.

candidates.headline: Broad active-learning question was not scoped
candidates.finding: A 2009 survey plus tutorials is background. Recent long-tail sample-selection work shows why current baselines must be reviewed.
candidates.required_next: Specify modality, label budget, annotation cost, dataset and a remaining empirical question; no claim of novelty from the current card.

candidates.headline: Current demand and unresolved gap not established
candidates.finding: Primary complaint was only seen in a search index; supporting vendor documents were historical. No local customer evidence or current comparison was established.
candidates.required_next: Read the complete report, check current alternatives and obtain evidence of a remaining operator problem before proposing a product.

candidates.headline: Resolved report misused
candidates.finding: Author accepted guidance on May 28; intentional replay behaviour was framed as opportunity evidence.
candidates.required_next: Retain only in the rejection log; do not restart.

candidates.headline: 2021 background paper misused
candidates.finding: Label-error research does not establish current consultancy demand.
candidates.required_next: Retain only as background; do not restart.

limits: This is an initial evidence audit, not a systematic literature review or LTU topic approval.
No new opportunity passed validation. No customer interviews, experiments, model downloads or dataset trials were performed.
Read scope is explicit per source. Abstract-only and inaccessible sources cannot establish novelty or unresolved status.
Trend is not established for any lead; longitudinal independent signals are missing.
Broad live metadata covers many domains, but this manual audit prioritised existing cards and a small cross-domain sample.
changes: Server-side hold blocks enqueue and new claims in both lanes; existing running work, selections and artifacts are preserved.
Scheduled agents are in audit mode; collections continue while recommendations/default builds remain held.
Digest now prioritises publication-age buckets: 30-day leads, 90-day corroboration, separate old/modified/unknown/future records.
Publication and verification dates must be shown separately. A current read does not make an old source new.
